stem: An isosceles triangle has two sides of length \(13\) and a perimeter of \(36\). What is the length of the third side?
solution: The two equal sides add to \(13 + 13 = 26\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is \(36 - 13\); only one of the two equal sides was subtracted.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This assumes all three sides are equal, but then the perimeter would be \(39\), not \(36\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \((36 - 26) \div 2\); the remaining \(10\) is a single side and should not be halved.

verify:
t=symbols('t')
ans=solve(Eq(13+13+t,36),t)[0]
assert ans==10
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
